{{Libra}}

Libra is the 11th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 41–44.

== Overview ==
I am thinking of making this month entirely the [[Book of Lehi]]

===Etymology===
English ''Libra'' "scales" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|天秤座|ja|Tenbin-za}} “scales-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 41–44 (Days [[Libra 1]]–[[Libra 28]]):   
===EVENTS===
* Libra 1 — Canada Thanksgiving / Japan Sports Day / US Columbus Day / Indigenous Peoples’ Day  
* [[Libra 21]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Halloween_falls_on|Halloween]]  
* [[Libra 28]] — [[:Category:Days_that_Halloween_falls_on|Halloween]]
